verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB documents a searchable query stats table where you can drill down to a single execution, see its time breakdown, and review grouped error signatures. It also exposes the full stock ClickHouse observability surface, queryable across the whole cluster, which gives solid query-profiling support for finding slow or expensive queries. Execution plans (EXPLAIN-style plan inspection) are never explicitly documented and are only implied by the claim that every ClickHouse query works unchanged. missing for 10: explicit execution-plan/EXPLAIN documentation, per-query resource/cost profiling detail, independent or hands-on corroboration.
